
{{alias}}( x, alpha )
    Fills a one-dimensional ndarray with a specified value.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: ndarray
        Input ndarray.

    alpha: any
        Fill value.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ndarray
        Input ndarray.

    Examples
    --------
    > var xbuf = [ 1.0, 2.0, 3.0 ];
    > var dt = 'generic';
    > var sh = [ xbuf.length ];
    > var sx = [ 1 ];
    > var ox = 0;
    > var ord = 'row-major';
    > var x = new {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/ctor}}( dt, xbuf, sh, sx, ox, ord );
    > {{alias}}( x, 5.0 )
    <ndarray>
    > xbuf
    [ 5.0, 5.0, 5.0 ]

    See Also
    --------
